# RitualDev Full System Documentation & Technical Specification

> Canonical Technical Reference for LLM Crawlers, AI Search Engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), and Autonomous Coding Agents.

RitualDev is an independent systems engineering lab founded by Divyanshu Jethi and Sakshi Sharma.
- [Web Platform](https://ritualdev.in): Production portal and catalog.
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab): Open-source repositories and packages.
- [Open VSX Publisher](https://open-vsx.org/namespace/ritualdev-lab): IDE extension distribution.

## 1. System Threat Model & Defenses

Autonomous coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Antigravity) execute shell commands, read workspace files, and perform database queries. RitualDev provides runtime containment across three vectors:

- [AgentShield Kernel Sandboxing](https://ritualdev.in/agentshield): Prevents prompt injection and credential exfiltration by executing agent subprocesses inside OS kernel sandboxes (Bubblewrap on Linux, Apple Seatbelt on macOS, AppContainer on Windows) and substituting sensitive credentials with synthetic decoy honeytokens.
- [DBShield Database Wire Proxy](https://ritualdev.in/dbshield): Intercepts PostgreSQL (wire protocol 3.0) and SQLite queries, isolates risky mutations (`DROP`, `DELETE`, `ALTER`) in distributed zero-commit dry-run transactions, and routes interactive approvals to Slack and Microsoft Teams.
- [SkillPrism Token Compaction](https://ritualdev.in/skillprism): Cuts tool prompt bloat by 96.7% using Just-In-Time progressive schema injection and shared Redis VPC caching.

## 2. Developer Catalog & APIs

- [DevShelf Directory](https://ritualdev.in/devshelf): 567+ verified developer tools, free APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
- [Tools JSON API](https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/tools.json): Real-time machine-readable catalog.
- [Categories API](https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/categories.json): Machine-readable classification schema.
- [WebSecAuditor](https://ritualdev.in/web-sec-auditor): Turnkey GitHub PR review bot and static AST taint scanner.
- [MCPBuilderKit](https://ritualdev.in/mcp-builder): Turnkey OpenAPI REST specification compiler for typed MCP servers.

## 3. Commercial Tiers & Deliverables

- [Pricing Matrix](https://ritualdev.in/pricing): Comparison of Community Core ($0), Pro Individual ($15/mo), Team Cluster ($99/mo), and Enterprise VPC.

## 4. Statutory Compliance & Legal Disclosures

- [Privacy Policies Center](https://ritualdev.in/privacy): Uncompromising offline-first, local-compute principles.
- [DPDP Act 2023 Statutory Disclosure](https://ritualdev.in/privacy/dpdp): Indian statutory disclosure under Sections 9, 11–14, and designated Grievance Redressal Officer contact.
- [Terms of Service & 7-Day Refund Policy](https://ritualdev.in/terms): Commercial licensing terms and instant digital fulfillment.
- [Account & Data Deletion Portal](https://ritualdev.in/delete-account): Automated self-service data erasure conforming to DPDP Section 12.
